_note: Manual v1 (2026-10-15) is the current Sweeteners and Syrups Program Manual for Category 31. The house DOI suffix hmtc.manual.sweeteners-and-syrups is reserved for deposit. cert_doi stays empty until that deposit. Method edition is at /program/method.

versions.label: Manual v1
versions.summary: First Category 31 Program Manual. Four live standards. Numeric ceilings are the values on those standards. Species with no separate number are capped at the parent total and tested on the program retest schedule. Metal safety only.
